description: The U.S. Federal Circuit ruled in Thaler v Vidal (2022) that an AI system cannot be an inventor under the Patent Act because it lacks human intentionality.

instances.assertion: The U.S. Federal Circuit ruled in Thaler v Vidal (2022) that an AI system cannot be an inventor under the Patent Act because it lacks human intentionality.
In Thaler v Vidal (2022), the US Federal Circuit ruled that AI cannot be an inventor because inventorship requires human intentionality.
